Author: T. Vinod Kumar
Bench: T. Vinod Kumar
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice T. Vinod Kumar
 Writ Petition Nos.32082 And 32089 Of 2024
Common Order:

Heard learned Counsel for the petitioners, learned Assistant Government Pleader attached to the office of the learned Advocate General appearing for respondents and with the consent of learned Counsel appearing for the parties, these Writ Petitions are taken up for hearing and disposal at the stage of admission.
2. The case of the petitioners, in brief, is that the respondent authorities while acquiring the land in Sy. Nos.16 and 141 situated at Tappetlamorsu village.

Gattu Mandal, Jogulamba Gadwal District by passing a consent Award on 15.02.2006 did not make payment of compensation towards value of structures existing in the land acquired though had noted the compensation for the structure will be added at the time of passing of next Award; and that inspite of more than 15 years having passed by since then, compensation in respect of the structures viz., water tank existing in their land has not been paid till date, which action it is contended is highly illegal and arbitrary and contrary to the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
3. Learned Assistant Government Pleader attached to the office of the learned Advocate General has placed before this Court the file relating to the aforesaid land acquisition proceedings.

A perusal of the file relating to the aforesaid land acquisition proceeding clearly shows that on the respondent authorities passing a consent Award acquiring the land of the petitioners, on the basis of letter addressed by the Land Acquisition Officer, the Executive Engineer having initiated proceedings for valuation of structures i.e., storage water tank existing in the land acquired from the petitioner i.e.,
Sy. Nos.16 and 141; and that the Abstract Estimate of the structure value of storage water tank as prepared by the Assistant Engineer countersigned by the Deputy Executive Engineer and the Executive Engineer of Irrigation & Command Area Development as forwarded by the Executive Engineer to the Land Acquisition Officer under the cover of letter dated 15.02.2008 shows that the structure value in respect of the water tank situated in Sy. No.16 belonging to the petitioner in W.P.
No.32082 of 2024 to be in a sum of Rs.3,02,008/- while that of the petitioner in W.P. No.141 in W.P. No.32089 of 2024 to be in a sum of Rs.2,78,738/-.
4.

Since, the respondent authority while passing consent award did not take into consideration the structure value for including the same in the compensation amount payable and having categorically noted therein that as the valuation is awaited from the Executive Engineer and the same would be Boya Hanumanthu Alias Boya Medikonda ... vs The State Of Telangana on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99090000/
1 added at the time of passing of next Award, did not pass supplementary Award though the respondent authorities having received the aforesaid value of structure from the Executive Engineer in February, 2008 itself.

sentences.text: The respondent authorities could not have kept silent by not paying the compensation amount towards the structures i.e., storage water tank existing in the land of the petitioners which was acquired by the respondent authorities for Jawahar (Nettampad) Lift Irrigation Project (JLIP), Gadwal.

5. Since, the Executive Engineer by its communication dated 15.02.2008 having informed the respondent authorities of the value of structures existing in the land acquired from the petitioners,
the respondent authorities were under an obligation to make the aforesaid payment to the petitioners thereafter.

However, the respondent authorities despite being in receipt of the valuation of the structures for making payment of structure compensation for the reasons best known remained silent and have deprived the petitioners from receiving the compensation for nearly 16 years despite the petitioners approaching the respondent authorities time and again.
It is for the said reason the petitioners were compelled to approach this Court by filing the present Writ Petitions.

6. Since, a perusal of the file by this Court relating to the aforesaid proceeding clearly indicates the respondent authorities having not paid the compensation in respect of the structures existing in the lands acquired from the petitioners under consent Award, this Court is of the view that the respondent authorities are to be directed to pay compensation amount for the structures as per the Abstract Estimate as furnished by the Executive Engineer under the cover of letter dated 15.02.2008.

7. Accordingly, the respondents are directed to make the payment of compensation to the petitioners for the structures as per the Abstract Estimate furnished by the Executive Engineer vide letter dated 15.02.2008 along with consequential benefit of interest thereon till the date of payment within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
8. Subject to the above direction, these Writ Petitions are disposed of.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in the Writ Petition, shall stand closed.
